description: List the CVEs whose EPSS score rose most over the last 7 or 30 days, with the old and the new score. Filter by vendor, product, KEV state or a minimum score. Call the cve_lookup tool for the details of a CVE.

in_kev.description: true lists only CVEs in CISA KEV, false only CVEs not in it

min_epss.description: Lowest current EPSS score to list, 0.0 to 1.0.

offset.description: CVEs to skip; pass next_offset of the previous page

product.description: Exact product name as cpe_search lists it, e.g. log4j

vendor.description: Exact vendor name as cpe_search lists it, e.g. apache

window_days.description: Days to look back: 7 or 30. Default 7.

name: epss_risers
title: EPSS Risers
